title: Charat Singh Is Outraged by the Pathan's Insult

blocks.text: A lone Pathan escalates the confrontation by daring any Singh to meet him with limited arms and by implying that refusal would amount to written admission of defeat. The insult is calculated to wound honor before the clash of steel even begins.

For a moment no one steps forward, and Charat Singh felt extremely outraged by that pause. His anger comes not from vanity alone but from the fear that hesitation may stain the reputation of the Khalsa before enemies already skilled in mockery.

Sukha Singh then intervenes with harder judgment. He recognizes the Pathan's size, armor, and tactical danger, so the page becomes a study in how zeal, honor, and disciplined caution must be held together before battle.
